title: QCTO Occupational Certificate: Cybersecurity Analyst — external assessment

domains.name: Analyse and solve security risks and vulnerabilities to safeguard information system assets

objectives.text: Check security practices against company policy and legal and regulatory requirements
Identify critical systems and critical information system assets
Run vulnerability tests on hardware, software and IT infrastructure
Collect data on current security measures for risk analysis and status reports
Choose the best way to secure the IT infrastructure and information assets
Maintain a risk catalogue and check it against incident reports

domains.name: Protect digital assets by maintaining attack mitigation and incident response capability

objectives.text: Analyse and implement anti-virus, firewall and defensive protocol updates
Safeguard information assets by finding and solving security problems
Grant credentials to authorised users, monitor access and check for unregistered changes
Implement security improvements from trend, risk and threat analysis
Implement and automate intrusion detection and prevention and its response protocols

domains.name: Run ethical security monitoring in line with policy to protect confidentiality, integrity and availability

objectives.text: Use monitoring and incident response toolsets to detect and trace intrusions
Detect incidents by analysing abnormalities, and report violations
Run periodic checks and tests, and update defensive protocols with the team
Apply ethics and a moral compass to cybersecurity work

domains.name: Run response procedures to mitigate attacks and secure assets, intellectual property and systems

objectives.text: Monitor and respond to identified attacks, apply defensive protocols and report incidents
Contain the event, close the vulnerability and resolve the incident
Collect security-measure data for risk analysis and write status reports
Investigate network intrusions and other breaches

domains.name: Run recovery procedures to restore data and assets affected by incidents

objectives.text: Find the breach vector and quarantine affected servers, devices and systems
Identify lost or stolen information, analyse impact and start remediation
Develop improvements from lessons learned and reviews of existing measures
Produce an incident close-out report with logs and supporting evidence
